subject: Infra fit + pilot path — recap & ask
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T16:32:00Z
Subject: Infra fit + pilot path — recap & ask

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a single place to track next steps and where Redwood's dedicated/private options map to your needs: 

What we heard
- Primary driver: reduce per-token cost and gain predictable throughput for peak hours across checkout and search (model: open LLM + retrieval).
- Data controls: must keep customer PII within your VPC and have audit logs surfaced to your security team.
- Timeline: procurement gating but goal is a pilot before end of Q1.

How Redwood can help (options we discussed)
- Dedicated capacity (hosted, reserved GPU pool): fast onboarding, predictable throughput, monthly committed units.
- Private VPC deployment: customer-managed networking, peering options, KMS integration for keys, SOC2 evidence sharing.
- On‑prem package: for air-gapped workloads if needed later — longer lead time.

Suggested next steps
1) I'll push a short pilot proposal (2-week scope) + cost estimate for dedicated vs VPC so you can compare economics — attaching a sketch of the pilot cost and a network checklist.
2) If your security team wants, we can share our SOC2 pack and a vendor security checklist (I can pull that together and coordinate with Karthik on specifics).
3) If procurement is involved, we'll add a short mutual action plan and SOW draft to speed approvals.

Can you confirm whether procurement or security want to be looped into the pilot scoping call next week? If yes, what days/times look good — I have flexibility Wednesday/Thursday mornings PST.

Attachments: pilot-cost-estimate.xlsx (stub), network-checklist.pdf (stub)

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Hi Sophie —

Just nudging this to the top of your inbox — wanted to check if priorities shifted or if there’s a preferred contact in procurement/security we should include before sending the SOW draft.

Short yes/no will do if you’re still evaluating this quarter.

Subject: Re: Infra fit + pilot path — recap & ask

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the follow-up and the recap — apologies for the delay, we were heads down on a release. Quick answers: 

- Pilot interest: yes, we want to move forward with a small pilot to validate throughput and cost. Likely preferred path is Private VPC deployment (peering + KMS) but we want the option to start on Dedicated if it shortens time-to-pilot.
- Security asks: please share SOC2 Type II evidence, data retention settings, and the vendor security checklist. Our SecOps has added a couple of network questions in the attached checklist.
- Procurement: included on this reply (procurement@nimbusretail.com) — they will want the SOW and a rough pricing band.
- Timeline: procurement will start review in mid-Jan; target pilot start late Jan / early Feb.

If you can send the SOC2 pack and a short SOW + cost band by EOD next Tuesday (2026-11-08), that will let procurement slot us for January reviews.

Attachment: vendor-security-checklist.pdf (from SecOps)

Cheers,
Sophie Li
Head of Platform, Nimbus Retail
Sophie.Li@nimbusretail.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-01T14:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Re: Infra fit + pilot path — prep items for SOC2 + SOW

Karthik / Ben —

Sophie confirmed a likely Private VPC preference but is open to starting on Dedicated to accelerate pilot. Procurement wants SOW + pricing band; SecOps attached a checklist with a few network/KMS-specific asks. Pilot target window: late Jan / early Feb.

Can we do the following by Tuesday EOD (2026-11-08)?
- Karthik: SOC2 Type II pack + a one-page summary of data-retention and KMS options (for SecOps).
- Ben: Draft SOW (2-week pilot scope) and two pricing bands (Dedicated vs VPC) — include onboarding estimate and any required network support hours.

I'll package everything and send to procurement + SecOps. If either of you need time, let me know — Sophie is flexible on timing but procurement has a strict January review window.

Thanks —
Grace
